sections.title: Media Control in Authoritarian Regimes
sections.description: This seminar examines the political logic of media regulation, censorship, propaganda, surveillance and repression in authoritarian regimes. In the course, we survey foundational texts related to information control in the political science literature. We explore themes of how authoritarian regimes control the media, how media control is challenged by citizens and social movements, and how strategies of information control and popular resistance to information control have changed along with the introduction of new information and communication technologies.
